author: GamingBolt
description:
Marvel’s Wolverine is certainly an explosive adventure from its start to that high-stakes fight with a big bad who made things quite personal for Logan. But of course, Wolverine won, paying a price that most would consider too high, but one that he has paid willingly not once, but twice. That ending, and all the stuff that it implies, tells us that there is more to this story that’s yet to come.

Well, that’s why we’re here. We’re diving into the story in Marvel’s Wolverine and speculating on where Logan’s winding road could take him next as he makes the most of his spot in Insomniac’s growing universe of superheroes.
title: Marvel's Wolverine Ending Explained And How It Sets Up Wolverine 2

author: GamingBolt
description:
EA SportsFC 27 is almost here, and we’ve been looking for every bit of new information we can ahead of its early access release in a few days. We’ve come away impressed with what it’s trying to do differently with respect to its predecessor, with changes that could directly make the new game feel quite different from what was on offer last year.

As always, we’ve been happy to lay it all out for you to help you decide if this one is going to have your attention right off the bat. Join us as we dive into what’s changed and how it aims to improve what’s on offer in FC 27, a title that’s going to keep us quite busy over the next few months and beyond.
title: EA Sports FC 27 vs FC 26 - 15 CHANGES  You May Not Know

author: GamingBolt
description: Seven years after the release of Remedy's stunning action-adventure; three years after its captivating survival horror; and now, just days before the launch of Control Resonant, its most ambitious game to date, we still don't know exactly what's going on or why. Of course, that is one of the biggest appeals – the excitement preceding the mystery.
title: Control Resonant Theory: What The Hell Is Even Going On?
